issue.title: Staged handoffs end through host completion
issue.description: Turn-ending commands (plan propose, questions, pipe, gate create, sudo request, launch request, run, monitor start) stage their handoff instead of killing the agent runner. Every root turn ends normally through /sase_final, the host runs the selected finalizers to their fixed point, and only then does a fixed host-owned step adopt the staged handoff. Agents can commit file changes and propose a plan (or start a monitor) in the same turn, and no handoff ever silently drops uncommitted work.

payload.entry: PREPARED-BRIDGE RESERVATION CONTRACT: persist these facts in the staged record payload *before* publishing the staged record; do not bind at staging time. Payload keys: prepared_intent_ref (artifact ref, local ref, or intent id accepted by load_prepared_completion) and prepared_reservation {staged_id, monitor_id, request_fingerprint, command} matching PreparedReservationWire. staged_id is the staged record UUID; command is the exact argv that will start; the intent stays in lifecycle state prepared until spawn binds it. Adapter: src/sase/finalizers/prepared_coverage.py. This child does not launch, reserve, or bind ToolRuns and does not change monitor/start_flow.py.

payload.entry: CUSTODY-ADOPTION SEAM: shared adopter seam in src/sase/axe/run_agent_exec_staged.py. Adopters are STAGED_HANDOFF_ADOPTERS[<kind>] returning legacy str|None (loop outcome, None continues inline) or StagedAdoptionOutcome(outcome, custodian). Dispatch normalizes via _normalize_adopter_result; explicit custodian wins, else derived from continuation state (successor_artifacts_dir when changed, else plan_gate_artifacts_dir, else current_artifacts_dir) via _resolve_adoption_custodian — never from command text. Origin custody persisted in agent_meta[carried_repositories] via _persist_origin_custody before the adopter runs (failed adoption leaves carried_to None); on success _mark_custody_transferred sets carried_to to the actual custodian. Record shape: {repo_id, digest, staged_id, origin_run, carried_to}. Evidence: finalizer_result.json instances[].evidence items with kind carried_repo/prepared_repo and value JSON {digest, repo_id, staged_ref}; coverage via commit_carry.proven_coverage_ids_from_result_payload matched against current context obligations plus staged_id. Settlement cross-checks descriptor staged_id/kind/successor_workspace/carry_allowed via _staged_identity_matches. Future questions/pipe/gate/monitor adopters reuse this seam; not implemented here.
